suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as acute cardiac complication. Apply to documented acute myocardial infarction, particularly STEMI consistent with the source, with separately documented ventricular arrhythmia occurring in the relevant post-infarction period. Do not generalize to every remote MI history. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Myocardial Infarction (Heart Attack) and Cardiac Arrhythmias (Atrial Fibrillation, Tachycardia)
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
